_comment: Authoritative content-modification dates for non-blog pages, used for sitemap <lastmod>. Update a route's date only when its visible content changes substantially. The /blog hub's lastmod is derived from the newest published article instead. Routes absent from this map are omitted from <lastmod> rather than guessed.
